overview_description.description: Natify is a UAE-based company that offers innovative and scalable native product placement solutions for games and metaverse environments. Non-intrusive approach to in-game advertising benefits both game owners and brands by maintaining the integrity of the game and improving the gaming experience for users. Natify's services include seamless native ad display, real-time tracking and billing, free implementation for game owners, targeted product placement based on geography, and data collection and reporting features for campaign optimization.
